channel.title: Texture Mods on ZooBerry
channel.description: Recent content in Texture Mods on ZooBerry

item.title: Palette Edits: Bongo
item.description: A small mod that edits the palette and various related graphics for the Bongo, making it less saturated and more like the real animal.

item.title: Muted Iron Bars
item.description: A small mod that edits the palette for both large and small iron bar fences to remove the blue hue, as well as updating the icons to match.

item.title: Natural Freshwater
item.description: A mod that edits the palette for fresh water tanks and various related graphics to give it a more natural look.
